source.title: Age of Friends — Statistics-to-Social Interpretation Matrix

tracks.definition: Meaningful daring offensive action in genuinely challenging entry circumstances.
Meaningful directed punishing pressure against a demonstrably disadvantaged opponent, or separately qualified economic betrayal.
A's substantive competition or counterplay against B.
A's distinct antagonism toward B beyond routine warfare.

notation.Q: Candidate strengthening, only if the track's independently justified conduct, context, identity and materiality predicates qualify.
notation.c: Supporting context only. Cannot itself produce a track change.
notation.W: Candidate weakening, requiring a separately justified positive action and approved predicate.

metricFamilies.sourceMetricOrEpisodeFamily: Detected Raids Initiated / directed economic pressure
metricFamilies.qualificationContext: Targeted, substantive, opponent-specific; challenge or prior vulnerability independently qualified.

metricFamilies.sourceMetricOrEpisodeFamily: Detected Battles / Skirmishes, pair-local contest
metricFamilies.qualificationContext: Attribution and individual participation, not mere episode count.

metricFamilies.sourceMetricOrEpisodeFamily: Return raid / independent reverse pressure
metricFamilies.qualificationContext: Reverse actor's own distinct action; chronology; no revenge motive.

metricFamilies.sourceMetricOrEpisodeFamily: Substantive defensive counterplay against an attacker
metricFamilies.qualificationContext: Defender actively resisted, repositioned or protected; passive victimhood is insufficient.

metricFamilies.sourceMetricOrEpisodeFamily: Direct opponent targeting in team Battle
metricFamilies.qualificationContext: Selective attention requires comparison with actual alternative opponents/opportunities.

metricFamilies.sourceMetricOrEpisodeFamily: Forward Buildings and Forward Eco placements
metricFamilies.qualificationContext: Specific opponent, geometry, genuine directed contest; no completion claimed.

metricFamilies.sourceMetricOrEpisodeFamily: Towers / Tower Rush with directed pressure
metricFamilies.qualificationContext: Punishing vulnerability needed for Cruelty; zoning alone is not Hostility.

metricFamilies.sourceMetricOrEpisodeFamily: Castle placement near opponent home
metricFamilies.qualificationContext: Generic contested placement only; special Forward Castle achievement remains separately proof-gated.

metricFamilies.sourceMetricOrEpisodeFamily: Gold Influence ≈ / contested gold-infrastructure positions
metricFamilies.qualificationContext: Rival ownership/contest not inferred from percent alone; no mined gold/real capture.

metricFamilies.sourceMetricOrEpisodeFamily: Cooperative Attacks against exact common enemy
metricFamilies.qualificationContext: Each attacker's own target-specific action may count versus enemy; common target alone cannot create ally Bond.

metricFamilies.sourceMetricOrEpisodeFamily: Defensive Assists (specific helper→recipient)
metricFamilies.qualificationContext: Intervention in independently threatened recipient's defense, materiality; not automatic rescue.

metricFamilies.sourceMetricOrEpisodeFamily: Reinforcements Sent (specific helper→recipient)
metricFamilies.qualificationContext: Real source-linked protective participation rather than nearby move/co-presence.

metricFamilies.sourceMetricOrEpisodeFamily: Defensive support under third-party pressure
metricFamilies.qualificationContext: Stronger context than generic assist; matching helper, threatened recipient, third-party source/time.

metricFamilies.sourceMetricOrEpisodeFamily: Tribute request donor→recipient
metricFamilies.qualificationContext: Existing request is not an automatic award; separately qualify helpful conduct and significance.

metricFamilies.sourceMetricOrEpisodeFamily: Repair/guard requests targeting a beneficiary's property
metricFamilies.qualificationContext: Need source-linked ownership, executed/credible material assistance and coverage.

metricFamilies.sourceMetricOrEpisodeFamily: Repeated independent pair contests across Battles
metricFamilies.qualificationContext: Versioned history, actual attributed conduct, distinct Games; no duplicate POVs.

metricFamilies.sourceMetricOrEpisodeFamily: Repeated, unusually selective targeted harassment
metricFamilies.qualificationContext: Cruelty requires earlier target disadvantage; Hostility requires distinct antagonism, not just focus fire.

metricFamilies.sourceMetricOrEpisodeFamily: Substantive hostile action after qualified effective alliance rupture
metricFamilies.qualificationContext: Ordered effective relationship plus distinct directed conduct; Bond weakening possible only if established prior Bond.

metricFamilies.sourceMetricOrEpisodeFamily: Material aid to former adversary with reconciliation context
metricFamilies.qualificationContext: Hostility cooling is helper→recipient's own direction; Cruelty reparative weakening requires same prior victim.

metricFamilies.sourceMetricOrEpisodeFamily: Serious directed antagonism against established cooperator
metricFamilies.qualificationContext: Independently qualified prior Bond, significance and ordered breach/harm; not simply playing opposite teams.

excludedStatistics.existingAofStatistic: Villager Queue Estimate @10/20, farms, economic buildings, TC placements, expansion zones

excludedStatistics.existingAofStatistic: Walls Before Feudal / Wall Tiles / Wall Style

excludedStatistics.existingAofStatistic: Scout Command Coverage @5, Command Map Coverage, Opponent-Base Command Contact
excludedStatistics.interpretationRole: Map intent and pressure context, not actual vision or courage

excludedStatistics.existingAofStatistic: Raw APM, Commands @5, Economy Actions in Battles, Combat-window APM

excludedStatistics.interpretationRole: Market transaction commands, not ally assistance
Trade-unit queue requests, not completed income

excludedStatistics.existingAofStatistic: Known Relics Targeted and First Relic Target Command

excludedStatistics.interpretationRole: Interaction inference, not confirmed opponent laming

excludedStatistics.existingAofStatistic: Battle results, Season points, victory/loss, opponent skill
excludedStatistics.interpretationRole: Historical stakes and past-only challenge context, not conduct themselves

developmentCandidates.reuseAofEvidence: Raid V3, Pair Episode Context V1, raidResponse, defender actions
developmentCandidates.priorityAndLimitations: P0. Independently active defender required. Timing alone insufficient.

developmentCandidates.reuseAofEvidence: Defensive Assists, Reinforcements, pressure-on-beneficiary, Context V2
developmentCandidates.priorityAndLimitations: P0. Exact helper, beneficiary, threat and source contribution.

developmentCandidates.reuseAofEvidence: Directed deeds across historical Games, prior directed episodes
developmentCandidates.priorityAndLimitations: P0. Opportunity-aware attribution and independently meaningful context.

developmentCandidates.potentialSocialUse: Bond; possibly Chivalry or Hostility cooling
developmentCandidates.priorityAndLimitations: P0 research. Request not verified receipt; bounded inference requires approval.
P1. Need timing/spatial relevance. Not confirmed sealed defense.
Partly exists. Requires specific threat linkage; no saved-unit claim.

developmentCandidates.candidate: Targeted repair of ally's threatened asset
developmentCandidates.priorityAndLimitations: P1. Target attribution and material effect uncertain.

developmentCandidates.reuseAofEvidence: Gold Influence, forward positions, directed pressure
developmentCandidates.priorityAndLimitations: P1. Infrastructure influence is not extraction or actual ownership.
P2. Opponent entitlement and actual interference not established.
P2. Confirmed conversion and ownership-change witness required.
P2. Income and beneficiary not currently established.

developmentCandidates.reuseAofEvidence: Economy Actions in Battles, skirmish context, APM
developmentCandidates.priorityAndLimitations: Already partly exists. No direct social points.
P2. Placement does not prove completed Wonder.

developmentCandidates.reuseAofEvidence: Relic targeting observations and future control proof
developmentCandidates.priorityAndLimitations: P2/post-V1. Current possession, theft and transfer fields are unavailable.

developmentCandidates.reuseAofEvidence: Effective alliance, king loss, responsible actor, victim judgment
developmentCandidates.priorityAndLimitations: Strict proof gate. Cannot infer from ordinary attacks.

independentWeakening.proposedQualifyingAction: Credible actor-owned abandonment of a chosen challenging commitment while independently verified opportunity/capacity remains
independentWeakening.falsePositiveGuardAndLikelyV1Status: Tactical retreat, loss, inactivity or a surrender command alone not enough; probably Pending until better witness.

independentWeakening.proposedQualifyingAction: Meaningful directed material relief/restitution from actor to the same prior harmed counterpart after qualified Cruelty
independentWeakening.falsePositiveGuardAndLikelyV1Status: Ordinary tribute request, helping someone else and simply ceasing attacks do not count; currently hard to qualify.

independentWeakening.proposedQualifyingAction: Independently demonstrated knowing withdrawal of a specific prior protective undertaking while attributable recipient need, capacity and reachable opportunity remained
independentWeakening.falsePositiveGuardAndLikelyV1Status: Failure to help, non-assistance, defeat and absence are not eligible; currently hard to qualify.

independentWeakening.proposedQualifyingAction: Positive actor-owned settlement/de-escalation explicitly tied to that pair, with qualified context or structured judgment
independentWeakening.falsePositiveGuardAndLikelyV1Status: Unplayed rematches, team changes, silence are not settlement; preserve stage-3 skill acknowledgment floor.

independentWeakening.proposedQualifyingAction: Substantive A→B reconciliation/aid toward A's former adversary, independently source-backed and tied to prior A→B Hostility
independentWeakening.falsePositiveGuardAndLikelyV1Status: B→A assistance cannot automatically reduce A→B Hostility; generic shared enemy/ceasefire is inadequate.

independentWeakening.proposedQualifyingAction: Serious independently qualified A→B directed antagonism against B, with established prior A→B support/Bond and historical significance
independentWeakening.falsePositiveGuardAndLikelyV1Status: Routine competition or opposite sides in later Battles insufficient. A→B only; do not mirror B→A.

ordinalGrades.meaning: Admitted independently meaningful ordinary strengthening episode
Independently admitted substantial episode with greater qualified significance
Substantial independently admitted weakening conduct, if separately approved
Neutral observation or context with no conduct effect
Unknown, incomplete, unauthenticated, LIMITED, PENDING or UNCONFIGURED
